Game Overview

In Farmers vs Aliens, the core idea is straightforward: defend your farm with clever tactics and quick reflexes in the zany world of Farmers vs Aliens. Armed with an array of weapons, outsmart strategic extraterrestrials while protecting your prized cow. Upgrade your defenses and adapt strategies as alien invaders challenge your mastery with increasing difficulty. Are you ready?

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Farmers vs Aliens is easy to pick up. Defend your farm with clever tactics and quick reflexes in the zany world of Farmers vs Aliens.
